{"rewrites":[{"transformation":"Decorrelates the EXISTS semi-join into an uncorrelated IN subquery. The correlation predicate li.product_id = p.id becomes p.id IN (SELECT li.product_id ...), and the join to orders and the filters on created_at and quantity stay inside the subquery. The EXISTS select-list constant ($2) is dropped, so the later placeholders are renumbered: original $3 becomes $2 and original $4 becomes $3.
